dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Visible 'O' and 'C' shaped structures along the lateral mid-section feature sharp, jagged dark perimeters with a rapid gradient transition to high-intensity light centers; edges are particularly defined on the dorsal-facing curves.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High density of small, irregular dark-pixel clusters concentrated around the anterior neck and facial region, transitioning to lower density, more isolated solid blobs on the lower lateral flanks.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three most prominent lateral rings form a near-equilateral triangular relationship in the mid-body area, with a fourth smaller blob creating a perpendicular offset toward the dorsal ridge.

other_distinctive_markers: The macro-annuli along the central lateral axis exhibit an interlocking, chain-like connectivity pattern, creating a continuous network of high-contrast boundaries.
